review.note: Reviewed all 9 Python entries across build/runtime/dev and 1 Node entry, including candidates beyond upper bounds. Core input is the explicitly supplied non-editable 0.42.0 wheel SHA-256 c7e3c56db5174ace5b15d9fdb25c3788e24938affbcbeffc6d3e3d6908358a9d, byte-verified against Core f8fdf37. Core 0.41.2 commit 64683c5 to f8fdf37 has no changes to public exports, config, domain, ports, vnext_facade or generated schema; the 0.42 breaking change removes the completed private offline conversion writer/tooling, which Komga does not use. Existing lower bound 0.41.1 remains supported; upper bound now excludes unverified lane 0.43. Existing requests upper bound excludes unverified major 3. Updated manifest boundary tests accept 0.42.0/0.42.1 and reject 0.43.0; installed dependency and read-only CLI tests passed (29 tests). A real nonempty public ingest-to-catalog experiment with the actual Core 0.42.0 wheel passed canonical lookup rejection, unchanged Komga synchronization through a fake gateway, metadata PATCH verification, scan/analyze coordination, stale revision rejection and unchanged SQLite bytes during reads. Reviewed official Ruff 0.16.9 release notes https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.16.9: keyword-call false-positive fixes for B009/B010/B043, lazy import annotations and preview fixes do not require policy changes; actual Ruff 0.16.9 lint/format and strict mypy passed. Other external candidates match the preceding reviewed receipt, whose official release-note review is retained in Git history. Installed latest candidates include Hatchling 1.32.4 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3; Markdown validation passed. All 29 installed Python packages passed dependency consistency. The exact final candidate full gate and installed-wheel smoke are reported separately; no live Komga, production database, live MariaDB or NAS validation is claimed.
